LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_DetonationOrb.nodes.0.des: Retains Detonation Orb stats and its original detonation without granting them twice. This relic has no original awakening fee. Its wearer may confirm tier one directly; later tiers retain the two-day recovery interval.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_DetonationOrb.nodes.1.des: Four consecutive ordinary hits on one enemy, at most 3 seconds apart, leave a warning at the impact. After 1.5 seconds, deal 50 damage each to up to 3 enemies within 3 cells and clear sight. Cooldown: 8 seconds. Switching targets resets the count; enemies may leave the warning area. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_DetonationOrb.nodes.2.des: Ordinary hits on two different enemies, with no more than 3 seconds between counted hits, deal 50 bonus damage each to up to 2 other enemies within 4 cells and clear sight of the second impact. Cooldown: 6 seconds. Repeated hits on the same target and secondary damage do not add counts. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_DetonationOrb.nodes.3.des: After Planted Charge damages an enemy, deal 25 additional damage to its first damaged victim, once per 8 seconds. An empty blast grants nothing; each blast can pay this bonus only once. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_DetonationOrb.nodes.4.des: After Planted Charge damages an enemy, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight of you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no ally, it is not redirected to you. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_DetonationOrb.nodes.5.des: Mark the first enemy actually damaged by Skipping Sparks for 5 seconds. One mark at a time, with a 6-second creation cooldown. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_DetonationOrb.nodes.6.des: After Skipping Sparks damages an enemy, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight of you, once per 6 seconds. One heal per discharge; missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
